hints.content: **Reflective (or line) symmetry** means that we can reflect a figure across a line, and the figure will remain unchanged.

##Reflection over $y=-x$

Under this transformation, some points on the nonagon map to another point which is no longer on the nonagon. The nonagon is *not symmetric* over this line.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A nanogon mapped onto a coordinate plane. The center is at the origin. The nanogon has a point at zero point five, seven, a point at five, five, a point at seven, one, a point at six, negative four, a point at two, negative seven, a point at negative three, negative six point five, a point at negative six point five, negative three, a point at negative seven, two, and a point at negative four point two, six. The equation y equals negative X is graphed on the coordinate plane. All points are estimates. There are dotted lines showing the location of the image after the shape is reflected over y equals negative X, but the endpoints of the lines are outside of the current pre image.

hints.content:
##Reflection over $y=-\dfrac23 x$

This line goes through the center of the nonagon and one of the corner points $(6,-4)$.

Under this transformation, each point on the nonagon maps to another point which is also on the nonagon.  The nonagon is *symmetric* over this line.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A nanogon mapped onto a coordinate plane. The center of the nanogon is at the origin. The nanogon has a point at zero point five, seven, a point at five, five, a point at seven, one, a point at six, negative four, a point at two, negative seven, a point at negative three, negative six point five, a point at negative six point five, negative three, a point at negative seven, two, and a point at negative four point two, six. The equation y equals negative two-thirds X is graphed on the coordinate plane. All points are estimates. There are dotted lines showing the location of the image after the shape is reflected over y equals negative two-thirds X. The endpoints of the lines overlap of the current pre image.

hints.content:
The symmetries that apply to the nonagon are:

Symmetry | Applies to the figure?
:- | :-:
Reflective symmetry over the line $y=-x$ | No
Reflection symmetry over the line $y=-\dfrac23 x$ | Yes
